### Painting and tool settings

Changing tools while drawing now waits for the stroke to finish. Save, clipboard and selection actions finish pending paint too. Undo removes the current stroke and waits for mouse release before accepting another one. Related to issues 224 and 231.

Brush, Pencil and Eraser remember their own settings across restarts, while selected colours stay shared. Pencil no longer shows Opacity, Flow, AA or brush dynamics. Its transparency comes from colour alpha. Related to issue 232.

### Shortcuts

More built-in commands can be assigned in Preferences > Keybinds, including menu commands, tools and guide actions. Commands stay together under their categories, and toolbar hints follow your current bindings. Related to issue 233.

The new defaults are Ctrl+Shift+X for Crop to Selection, Ctrl+H for clockwise canvas rotation and Ctrl+G for anticlockwise rotation. Existing custom bindings are preserved.

### Interface and language

The docked tool options bar now blends into the workspace when its Background opacity is reduced, without moving the canvas. Related to issue 223.

English uses consistent Australian spelling. Language names and codes are displayed separately so Arabic's code reads correctly. Existing language choices and personal labels are preserved. Related to issue 230.

The brush and shortcut guides have also been updated.
